bug_info.bug_desc: When software writes to the DCSR register in debug mode, the read-only 'cause' field is incorrectly overwritten with the written value. According to the RISC-V Debug Specification, the 'cause' field is read-only to software and should retain its previous value on any write. The buggy code assigns dcsr_d.cause = debug_cause_i only during debug entry (debug_csr_save_i), but during a normal CSR write to DCSR, the entire dcsr_d is overwritten from csr_wdata_int without preserving the read-only cause field, allowing software to corrupt the debug cause information.
bug_info.fix_hint: After applying software write data to DCSR, overwrite `dcsr_d.cause` with `dcsr_q.cause` so the hardware-maintained read-only cause field is preserved.
